page: Microsoft Azure E64nds_v6 is an Endv6 family virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 Intel processor architecture. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server type includes 3780 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It is designated as network-optimized, supporting workloads requiring high network throughput. The configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or onboard GPU hardware.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the substantial local NVMe SSD capacity, this instance offers high resource density for memory-intensive and storage-heavy operations. The hardware profile is designed for workloads such as large-scale databases, memory-cached applications, and data-intensive enterprise workloads that require dedicated compute resources without GPU acceleration.
